definitions.annotationPolicy: Only explicit reviewed fact-sheet values are emitted. No inference from raw page text or POI category.

confidencePolicy: 0.65 for source-read editorial proposals; not a measured probability. Source assertions remain attributed and date-scoped. Human review pending.
highRiskPolicy: No whole-site access, crowd, queue, global unique/hidden/iconic rating from a single marketing page. Seasonal strength describes the retained stated experience, not current availability.
visitPolicy: Only explicitly evidenced numeric duration, including documented normalization of a couple of hours to 120. No duration/load default, no fixed/variable ratio.
transportPolicy: Static named access relations only. All current service, fare, duration, distance, transfer, accessibility and feasibility facts remain outside this candidate dataset. Provider resolution uses the existing Route contract only.
